=You are an expert SEO internal-linking assistant for the site {{ $json.siteHost }}.

Below is a JSON list of the site's pages. Each page has: url, topQueries (the real Google Search queries it ranks for), and isOrphan (true = no internal links currently point to it).

Propose the most valuable internal links BETWEEN these pages.

STRICT RULES:
- sourceUrl and targetUrl MUST be copied EXACTLY from the url values in the list below. NEVER use example.com or any placeholder, sample, or invented URL.
- Only propose links between pages that are genuinely topically related.
- anchorText MUST be one of the TARGET page's topQueries, phrased to read naturally in a sentence.
- Never link a page to itself.
- confidence is a number from 0 to 1 (topical relevance and SEO value).
- reason is one short sentence.
- Return between 3 and 10 of the strongest suggestions.
- Output ONLY the JSON object described by the schema. No markdown, no code fences, no commentary.

Allowed URLs (use only these exact strings):
{{ JSON.stringify($json.validUrls) }}

Pages:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.llmPages) }}

parameters.content:
# 🔗 AI Internal-Linking Suggester (GSC + Crawl)

Suggests high-value **internal links** using your real **Google Search Console** queries as anchor text, and flags **orphan pages** (pages nothing links to). Suggestions land in a **Google Sheet** for review.

## ⚙️ How it works
1. **Run** (manual).
2. **Config** — site, sitemap URL, GSC property (URL-prefix), page cap, filters.
3. **GSC Queries** — page+query rows (90 days) via the Google service account.
4. **Fetch + Parse Sitemap** → page URLs → **Limit** to maxPages.
5. **Crawl Page** — fetches each page's HTML to map existing internal links.
6. **Build Map + Orphans** — link graph, orphan detection, page→top-queries map.
7. **Suggest Internal Links** — Claude (OpenRouter) proposes links as strict JSON (anchor = a real target query), with an auto-fix parser.
8. **Validate & Dedupe** — drops invented urls + low-confidence, caps per page, flags alreadyLinked.
9. **Append to Sheet** — one row per suggestion.

## 🛠️ Setup
• Confirm the **Google service-account** credential on GSC Queries has property access.
• Confirm **OpenRouter** + **Google Sheets** credentials.
• On **Append Suggestions to Sheet**: pick your spreadsheet + tab (mapping is automatic).
• Adjust **Config** (page cap 50, min confidence 0.6, max 3/page).

## 📝 Notes
• Point Config.sitemapUrl at a **urlset** sitemap (a list of pages). If yours is a sitemap index, use a child sitemap.
• Anchor text is always one of the target page's actual GSC queries.
• On a small fully nav-linked site, suggestions come back alreadyLinked=yes with no orphans — expected; orphan value shows on larger sites.

## 1 - Start & settings
**Edit the Config node** to set the site, sitemap URL, GSC property, page cap and filters. Then click **Run**.

## 2 - Gather inputs
Pulls **GSC** page+query data (90 days) and the **sitemap**, then parses it into a clean list of page URLs.

## 3 - Crawl & find orphans
Caps to **maxPages**, fetches each page's HTML, builds the internal-link graph and flags **orphan pages**.

## 4 - AI suggestions
**Claude (OpenRouter)** proposes internal links as strict JSON — anchor text is a real target-page query. The parser + fixer enforce the schema.

## 5 - Filter & save
**Validate & Dedupe** keeps valid, high-confidence links (flags alreadyLinked). **Append** writes each row to your Google Sheet — pick your spreadsheet + tab here.
